summary: Backend-only retest of the PHP backend (PHP 8.2 + SQLite harness, php -S 0.0.0.0:8888) after iteration-11 fixes. Ran the full previous suite (test_php_string_ids.py + test_php_iteration11.py) plus a NEW 25-case suite test_php_iteration12.py targeting the two HIGH defects from iteration 11. Combined result: 84 passed, 1 env-skip, 0 failed. BOTH iteration-11 HIGH issues are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) PUT /api/repairs/index.php now builds the SET clause dynamically from array_key_exists, so PARTIAL payloads no longer wipe omitted columns - reproduced the exact iteration-11 case (iPhone/X/SN1/orig/n1/50000/10000 then PUT {"notes":"only notes"}) and GET returns all original values intact with notes updated; also verified fee-only, technician-only, status-only and empty-body ({} = no-op) PUTs, and that an EXPLICIT "" still clears a column (intentional clears not blocked). Full-object PUT (status + all 8 fields + completed_at stamping) still persists everything (iteration-10 fix has not regressed). (2) PUT /api/users/index.php?id=<own id> now returns 200 for technician AND cashier changing their OWN password; login with the new password succeeds and the old password is rejected 401. Non-admin PUT on ANOTHER user's id still 403 and the victim's password is unchanged; unauthenticated PUT is 401; non-admin role escalation is silently ignored (role stays technician); non-admin full_name="" is ignored (no wipe). Users partial PUT no longer blanks role/full_name (admin phone-only and password-only PUTs keep role='technician' and full_name intact); admin can still legitimately change role/full_name and an invalid role returns 400. reply.php POST/DELETE role guards and the completed_at/picked_up_at COALESCE no-restamp behaviour still pass. Global exception handler on dashboard/stats.php still returns exactly {"error":"Internal server error"} (HTTP 500) with no path/stack-trace/SQLSTATE leak.

minor.issue: No password strength/length validation on PUT or POST (password_hash accepts a 1-char password). Frontend enforces rules, but the API does not - a direct call can set a trivial password.

Design note (not tested this iteration): the mirror sends the whole localStorage user object, which contains the PLAINTEXT password on every user edit, so PHP re-hashes the same password on unrelated edits. Works, but consider sending password only when it actually changed.
ENV-ONLY: MySQL-only DATE_FORMAT/DATE_SUB/CURDATE cannot run on the SQLite harness so it 500s here (clean generic JSON error). Business output still UNVERIFIED - must be checked on the VPS MySQL.
ENV-ONLY skip (1 skipped test): SELECT ... FOR UPDATE unsupported by SQLite. Correct for MySQL prod but not exercised here.

action_items: No blocking backend defects remain in the tested scope. Optional: add server-side password length validation to POST/PUT /api/users.
Verify /api/dashboard/stats.php and /api/repairs/parts.php on the real VPS MySQL - both are untestable on the SQLite harness.
critical_code_review_comments: repairs/index.php PUT: dynamic $map + array_key_exists SET builder is correct and preserves intentional '' clears - good fix, no further change needed.

users/index.php PUT: $isSelf check plus admin-only role/full_name whitelist is the right shape; role from a non-admin is silently dropped (no 403), which is acceptable but consider returning 403 so clients notice a rejected escalation attempt.
users PUT returns the row without password_hash - verified, no hash leak.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral SQLite harness /tmp/klinikkana_test.sqlite (recreated per run). Test rows r_qa_i12_partial, u_qa_i12_tech, u_qa_i12_other created and deleted by the tests.
test_credentials: PHP API admin/admin123 (test users qa_i12_tech / qa_i12_other created+deleted by the suite)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bootstrap: pkill -f 'php -S 0.0.0.0:8888'; rm -f /tmp/klinikkana_test.sqlite; cd /app/php-backend && nohup php -S 0.0.0.0:8888 -t /app/php-backend >/tmp/php_server.log 2>&1 &  then: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_php_string_ids.py tests/test_php_iteration11.py tests/test_php_iteration12.py -n 0 -p no:randomly -q  (use -n 0: pytest.ini forces -n 2 and the PHP built-in server is single-threaded). All three files are green as of iteration 12. Open items are env-only: dashboard/stats.php and repairs/parts.php need real MySQL. Frontend has not been retested since iteration 11.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-11 defects were (a) the repairs PUT writing a fixed 8-column list with `?? ''` / 0 fallbacks (data loss on partial payloads) and (b) users PUT guarded by require_role(['admin']) (403 on self password change). Both are resolved by dynamic array_key_exists-driven SET clauses and an $isSelf allowance with an admin-only field whitelist; verified end-to-end including login with the new password.
